title: Voyager Golden Record music selection (Bach 'would just be bragging')

tellings.quote: My favorite story of that was somebody said, "Well, we got to put uh Bach on the record." And somebody said that would just be bragging. [laughter]

plain: While NASA's team was choosing the music for the Golden Record, a disc of sounds and songs sent into space on the Voyager probes in 1977, someone said they had to include Bach, and someone else answered that it "would just be bragging". The well-known skeptic Michael Shermer tells this to Michels as his favourite story from the project. He heard it in the audio version of a book about the record, which he does not name, and it involves the astronomer Carl Sagan and a team member he calls Annie.
